basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Gorakhpur (Kunraghat, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh) has advertised 56 Group-A faculty posts across 27 departments: 16 Professor, 5 Additional Professor, 19 Associate Professor and 16 Assistant Professor. Posts are on regular, deputation or contractual basis, with pay from Level-12 to Level-14A of the 7th CPC. The Google form and the hard copy sent by Speed/Registered Post are due by 24 December 2026 (advertisement opened 25 November 2026; Advt. No. AIIMS/GKP/RECT/FACULTY/2026-27/287).

how_to_apply: Applications must reach the institute in two ways: the Google form at https://forms.gle/L1fQkGNmDXDpboSd8, latest by 24 December 2026, and the signed hard copy sent by Speed/Registered Post to the Recruitment Cell by 24 December 2026, failing which the candidature will not be considered.
Fill in the application form in MS Word format as per the proforma given with the notice, take a printout, affix photograph and signature, and scan it in pdf format.

Upload on the Google form: the filled application, the filled Brief of the Candidate (Annexure-A, pdf), the filled Power Point Presentation (Annexure-B, MS PowerPoint), scanned educational certificates (SSLC to PG; Ph.D for non-medical posts), scanned experience certificates, other relevant documents and latest registration certificates (UG and PG).
Combine all relevant certificates into a single PDF file in the order listed in the notice and upload it on the Google form.
Pay the application fee, where applicable, online to the bank account given below.

Send the duly signed application form with Annexure-A and self-attested photocopies of supporting documents (age, qualification, experience, category) by Speed/Registered Post to: RECRUITMENT CELL, AIIMS GORAKHPUR, ADMINISTRATIVE BLOCK, KUNRAGHAT, GORAKHPUR – 273008.
Super-scribe the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ... (name of the post applied for)".

Deputation applicants must also forward the application through proper channel with the printout, documents related to date of birth, education and experience, No Objection Certificate, Vigilance Clearance Certificate, APAR/ACR for the last 05 years and the Annexure-3 proforma. This must reach the same address within 15 days from the last date of online submission, with the envelope marked "Application for the Post of ... on Deputation basis in the Dept. Of ...". Applications without vigilance clearance and APAR/ACR dossiers will not be considered. Details cannot be changed after submission.

The fee is paid online to State Bank of India, Branch Giridharganj, Gorakhpur-273008; account holder Recruitment cell, AIIMS, Gorakhpur; Account No 42368584553; IFSC SBIN0018457. Any other instrument of payment is not acceptable and the fee is non-refundable. Annexure-2 states that the fee is exempted for all candidates applying as retired faculty on contract basis. A candidate applying for more than one post must apply separately and pay the fee for each post.

Based on bio-data, the Search cum Selection Committee may short-list candidates for interview. The interview will be held in Gorakhpur only. The list of eligible candidates, date, time and venue will be put up on the institute website. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Candidates called must produce original documents with photocopies for verification.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Gorakhpur
content_sections.text: According to the notice, AIIMS Gorakhpur was established under PMSSY to improve regional imbalances in the availability of affordable and reliable tertiary healthcare and to add facilities for quality medical education. The institute started functioning from session 2018-19. Applications are invited by the Executive Director from Indian nationals and Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholders under Section 7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 56 vacancies (Professor 16, Additional Professor 5, Associate Professor 19, Assistant Professor 16). Vacancies are provisional and subject to variation, including reserved vacancies. A dash means no vacancy.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Age and all other qualifications are counted as on the closing date, 24 December 2026. Experience is counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification. A relaxation of one year of teaching/research experience applies to candidates applying for SC/ST reserved posts, as per DoPT rules and guidelines. For super-speciality disciplines, the first essential qualification (MBBS or equivalent) stays the same and the second is D.M. or M.Ch (recognised under the IMC Act, 1956 or by the NMC, or NMC-recognised equivalent) in the subject of the post. Experience is counted after the qualifying degree and must be gained in an NMC-recognised department or equivalent. Professor: twelve years for a 02 or 05 year course; eleven years for a 03 or 06 year course. Additional Professor: eight years for a 02 or 05 year course; seven years for a 03 or 06 year course. Associate Professor: four years for a 02 or 05 year course; three years for a 03 or 06 year course. Assistant Professor: one year for a 02 or 05 year course; no additional experience for a 03 or 06 year course. Medical Oncology (Assistant Professor): candidates with a 2 or 3 year DM degree must have obtained the MD degree (or NMC-recognised equivalent) in Medicine or Pediatrics. For NMC criteria on equivalent qualification and experience, the notice refers to gazette F. No. NMC/MCI-23(1)/2021-MED dated 14th February 2022, mentioned as Annexure-C. For deputation, the notice gives a maximum of 56 years for Additional Professor and 58 years for Professor, as on the last date of receipt of application. Retired faculty from Institutes of National Importance and Government Medical Colleges at Professor or Additional Professor level, up to the age of 68 years, may apply on contract basis. No age relaxation is available to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying for unreserved vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Contract: initial period not exceeding one year, extendable by another one year or till age 70 or till the post is filled by regular appointment, whichever is earliest. The period may be reduced or extended at the sole discretion of the Competent Authority. Remuneration is consolidated, all inclusive and subject to tax deduction at source and other statutory deductions; payment is subject to satisfactory output. Duties: clinical, teaching and research duties, besides other work deemed fit by the Executive Director. The consultant reports to the Executive Director. Thirty (30) days leave in a calendar year, on cumulative basis. Participation in national seminars/conferences is permissible as per entitlement of regular faculty. Termination at any time with one month's notice by either side; the notice period may be shortened by paying remuneration in lieu of the shortfall. The consultant will not engage in any other paid assignment during the contract and must work whole time for the Institute. Deputation is open only for Professor and Additional Professor. The initial period is 03 years, further extendable as per DoPT regulations. Reservations do not apply to deputation posts. Regular appointment is subject to review and probation of two years. An appointee will not be issued a No Objection Certificate to apply elsewhere during the first 02 years of joining. Appointment is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit by a competent Medical Board.

faq.question: Q1. How many faculty vacancies are there in AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 56 vacancies: 16 Professor, 5 Additional Professor, 19 Associate Professor and 16 Assistant Professor, across 27 departments. The vacancies are provisional and subject to variation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 24 December 2026. The Google form and the hard copy sent by Speed/Registered Post are both due by this date; the advertisement opened on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for AIIMS Gorakhpur faculty posts?
faq.answer: MBBS or equivalent plus MD or MS in the subject of the post, recognised under the IMC Act, 1956 or by the NMC. Super-speciality disciplines require D.M. or M.Ch in the subject, with teaching experience that depends on the post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Gorakhpur faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: Professor and Additional Professor: not exceeding 58 years. Associate Professor and Assistant Professor: not exceeding 50 years, as on 24 December 2026. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 5 years for PWD (OPH) and Government Servants/Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for AIIMS Gorakhpur faculty posts?
faq.answer: Professor is Level-14A (168900-220400), Additional Professor Level-13A2+ (148200 – 211400), Associate Professor Level-13A1+ (138300 – 209200) and Assistant Professor Level-12 (101500 – 167400), plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 2,000/- for General/OBC/EWS and Rs. 500/- for SC/ST. PwBD candidates and retired faculty applying on deputation or contractual basis are exempted. The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur faculty posts?
faq.answer: Submit the Google form at https://forms.gle/L1fQkGNmDXDpboSd8 with the listed documents, and send the signed application with Annexure-A and self-attested copies by Speed/Registered Post to the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Gorakhpur, by 24 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The Search cum Selection Committee may short-list candidates based on bio-data, followed by an interview held in Gorakhpur. The interview date, time and venue will be put up on the institute website.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired faculty apply, and what will they be paid?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired faculty from INIs and Government Medical Colleges, up to age 68, may apply as Professor (Consultant) at Rs. 2,20,000 per month or Additional Professor (Consultant) at Rs. 2,00,000 per month, on contract for an initial period not exceeding one year.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate applying for more than one post in terms of different designation or department must apply separately for each post and pay the application fee for each post.
